name: Managed individual beta hypothesis
assumptions: Prices are internal hypotheses, exclude sales tax, and are not approved or customer-visible.
Annual subscribers are charged once per year, so the fixed payment fee is amortized over 12 months.
AI inference is customer-funded through bring-your-own keys and contributes zero operator inference cost.
Fixed operating cost is an editable planning allowance, not a vendor quote or spending approval.
The support reserve is not measured labor cost; pilot time tracking must replace it.
Refunds, disputes, foreign exchange, tax tooling, legal work, founder salary, and customer acquisition are excluded.
